infer_tests_to_run: infer which tests to run by analyzing the git diff and module dependency graph for a PR
get_modified_python_files: get the list of modified Python files between the current commit and the main branch or last commit
create_reverse_dependency_map: create a reverse dependency map showing which modules and tests depend on each file in the diffusers repo
parse_commit_message: parse a git commit message to detect CI skip, no filter, or test all commands
filter_tests: filter out tests in specified folders from the generated test list output file
